note: The first state worked off the federal gap list. 21 RIDB rows, 13 of them likely_rv by catalog; 9 added, 3 excluded, 1 held. Recorded so a later pass does not re-offer what was already judged.

excluded.name: WHITE ROCK MOUNTAIN RECREATION AREA
excluded.why: every catalog site that states a length caps at 20 ft; EKKO is 23 ft and the rule does not rely on squeezing into a 20-ft pad

excluded.name: Lake Wedington
excluded.why: recreation.gov: all campgrounds, cabins and reservable buildings CLOSED until further notice after infrastructure damage. Re-check later; the catalog itself looked like a real 16-site RV campground

excluded.name: NOTREBES BEND PARK
excluded.why: recreation.gov Important Notices says currently closed, which is what the catalog was already saying: 30 RV sites and NONE bookable. Re-check later; satellite showed a genuine riverfront loop on the Arkansas River

held.name: Blue Ridge Park (Dierks Lake)
held.why: 21 bookable sites with 30-amp electric and water, and satellite shows a real drive-in loop on a Dierks Lake point that would earn lakefront - but the catalog states NO site length and NO permitted-equipment list, and the rec.gov page gives neither. Absent is not too-small, so this is a hold rather than an exclude: confirm max RV length with the Dierks Lake Project Office (870-286-2346) and add it

dropped_by_triage.name: CARDEN POINT
dropped_by_triage.verdict: thin, a lone group picnic shelter
